title: [3.0.0.1-dev-b] Ok-Cancel in black in Time or Date Picker Dialog
symptom: In the Time or Date Picker Dialog, the Ok-Cancel buttons appear in black, making them unreadable or hard to see.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread, with credits to osodebailar. The commit link is https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/1aa76ed1ed3dd4c86746f60b83e8f15f5c1c38d3.
